author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I’m resurfacing the exterior of my 1970s garage and fixing 50 years of problems along the way, including rotten wood, old door jambs, water management, house wrap, exterior trim, siding and proper sealing. I’ll show you how I rebuild and waterproof an older garage exterior so it looks modern and, more importantly, keeps water moving away from the house.

Want to see the full siding installation from start to finish?  Watch my full siding install 👉🏼 https://youtu.be/qhsfv9os8EU
